image_description: A close-up view of a vintage-style wall-mounted barometer. The instrument features a brass or gold-colored metal casing with a vertical rectangular backplate and a circular dial at the bottom. The dial has a white face with black markings and hands, surrounded by a green and gold rim. Above the main dial is a smaller, secondary circular gauge or thermometer, also with a metallic finish. The image appears slightly soft-focused or low-resolution.
